entries.gap: CODING-STANDARDS.md did not state that filter/gate service methods calling a repository must catch exceptions and return a safe default — an unhandled exception silently aborts the entire delivery pipeline.
entries.proposed_change: Added rule: filter/gate services must wrap repository calls in try/catch and return the fail-open default (true for ALLOW filters) on exception, with error logging.
